headline: Marvin Harrison Jr. Passes Texans Physical; Houston’s Week 5 Result Affected Trade?

headline: Source: Packers lose DT Javon Hargrave for season to torn Achilles
summary: Tests confirmed Monday that Packers defensive tackle Javon Hargrave suffered a season-ending torn Achilles in Sunday's victory over the Bears, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

headline: Lions’ Tom Kennedy Likely To Undergo Season-Ending Knee Surgery; Devin White Suffers Broken Forearm
summary: The Lions improved to 3-2 with a 45-21 thrashing of the Cardinals on Sunday, but they did not escape Arizona unscathed. Wide receiver/returner Tom Kennedy and linebacker Devin White each went down with significant injuries in the first half. headline: Cowboys bring in Mike Pettine to assist first-year DC Christian Parker
summary: The struggling Dallas Cowboys are bringing in longtime NFL coach Mike Pettine as a senior defensive assistant to work with first-year DC Christian Parker.

headline: Eagles RB Will Shipley To Miss Time; Latest On Saquon Barkley, DeVonta Smith

headline: LaFleur: 1-4 Cardinals not planning to change playcallers
summary: Mike LaFleur says he does not plan on making changes to any of Arizona's coaching duties after a 1-4 start.
